subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The boy, Robi was signing a philosophical song with deep sweet tune which he composed. (b) So, Robi often felt lonely and spend most of his time with the servants. (c) One day something very interesting happened. (d) His father was a rich landlord and always remained busy with his work. (e) There was once a talented boy named Rabindranath Tagore. (f) Hearing the song from another room, his father was deeply impressed and order the servant to bring Robi in front of him. (g) His father told that the Mughal Emperors honoured the talented people with gifts and this incident inspired him to write more. (h) Robi was scared but after a few minutes he became astonished to see a cheque for 500 rupees given by his father.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
